notes.title: v0.9.3 release
notes.notes:
- Functionality: new camera control algorithm which will make sure that the game world is always at the view center no matter how players manipulate the camera. Much better viewing experience especially for top down games.

- Profile:
 + New profiles: Felix the Cat, Gradius, Burger Time
 + Improvement: new 3D Battle Scene for Final Fantasy
 + Fix bugs: 
  * Zelda 2: Fix bugs for Zelda 2 randomizer versions of game
  * Simon Quest: wrong layer of church curtains 
  * DrMario: scores weren't displayed in 2 player modes
  * Dragon Warrior I: dialog is invisible in default camera position
  * Final Fantasy : some minor bugs

- Last but not least currently many games profile are being dead blocked because I can not play through the game. If you can and want to offer this kind of help, please contact me, the best way is via Discord server at https://discord.gg/2ZP6mRq

notes.title: V0.9.2 release: RPG support milestone

notes.title: V0.9.1 Halloween Release : additional iconic games supported!
notes.notes:
4 new profiles added:
- Castlevania II: Simon's Quest
- Zelda II: The Adventure of Link
- Solomon's Key

Moreover there are dozen community profiles hosted at [url=https://geod.itch.io/3dsen-maker/community]Itch[/url]. You can always try it by downloading and importing into 3dSen.

Happy Halloween Everyone!

notes.title: Version 0.9 - Custom Profile Support Milestone
notes.notes:
- Support Adding/Removing external 3D profiles. Custom profiles are hosted at:
[url=https://geod.itch.io/3dsen-maker/community]Community Repository[/url]
- Support Removing savestates
- Support different TV modes: NTSC, PAL, DENDY 
- Memory optimization: reduce ~ 50Mb of runtime memory
- Support 7z format
- Improve game/savestate presentation layout
- Improve/fixbug file browser
- Zapper triggered by mouse left click

notes.title: 3dSen PC release date : 19 June 2020
notes.notes:
Hello everybody,
I'm very happy and proud to announce that 3dSen PC will be EA released on Steam on 19 June 2020.
It will mark 5 years since i started working on this project and 4 years since the first ever build was released! I just can't wait for that day to come :)
